title: SSC Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025 Result 2026 Out for 443 Post
intro: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has Officially Released Result for the Post of Head Constable  (AWO/ TPO) Male/ Female in Delhi Police Recruitment 2025 for 443 Post. Exam Held On January 15-22, 2025 & Result Available May 29, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: General/ OBC/ EWS : Rs. 100/-
SC/ ST/ Female (All Cat.) Rs. 00/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode
Online Apply Start On : 24 September 2025
Registration Last Date : 15 October 2025 (11:00 PM)
Fee Payment Last Date : 16 October 2025 (11:00 PM)
Correction Date:  31 Oct. to 02 Nov. 2025 (11:00 PM)
Self Slot Booking : 05 Dec. to 15 Jan 2026
Exam City Details : January 2026
Admit Card Available : January 2026
CBT Exam Date: 15-22 January 2026
Answer Key Available : 05 February 2026
Minimum. Age : 18 Years.
Maximum. Age : 27 Years.(UR/ EWS)

Age Relaxations permissible beyond the upper age limit for different categories of applicants, including SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), Ex-Servicemen (3 years after deduction of military service), Sportspersons (5 to 10 years depending on SC/ST status and level of representation), and Departmental candidates of Delhi Police (up to 40, 43, or 45 years based on their category: UR/EWS, OBC, or SC/ST, respectively).
Age Calculator:  Click Here

Passed 10+2 (Senior Secondary) from a recognized Board with Science & Mathematics as subjects. OR
																National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the trade of Mechanic-cum- Operator Electronic Communication System.
Proficiency in Computer Operation Qualifying in Nature.
Test of English word processing speed-1000 key depressions in 15 minutes.
Test of Basic Computer Functions:- Opening/Closing of PC, printing, MS office usage, saving & modification in typed text, paragraph setting & numbering, etc.

Height: The minimum requirement is 170 cm, which is relaxable by 5 cm. A reduced height requirement of 165 cm applies to residents of specified Hill areas (like Garhwalis, Gorkhas, Dogras, etc.), candidates from certain North-Eastern states, ST candidates, and sons of serving, retired, or deceased Delhi Police personnel/Multi-Tasking Staff.

Chest: The minimum requirement is 81−85 cm with a mandatory minimum expansion of 4 cm. And 5 cm relaxation in chest measurement is available for residents of the specified Hill areas, ST candidates, and sons of serving, retired, or deceased Delhi Police personnel/Multi-Tasking Staff.

Height: The minimum requirement is 157 cm, which is relaxable by 5 cm. A reduced height requirement of 152 cm applies to residents of specified Hill areas (like Garhwalis, Gorkhas, Dogras, etc.), candidates from certain North-Eastern states, ST candidates, and sons of serving, retired, or deceased Delhi Police personnel/Multi-Tasking Staff.
Chest: Not Required
Candidates up to 30 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 7 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 12.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3.5 feet.
Candidates above 30 to 40 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 8 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 11.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3.25 feet.
Candidates above 40 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 9 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 10.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3 feet.
Candidates up to 30 years must complete the 800-meter race in 5 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 9 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3 feet.
Candidates above 30 to 40 years must complete the 800-meter race in 6 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 8 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 21/2 feet.
Candidates above 40 years must complete the 800-meter race in 7 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 7 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 21/4 feet.
Pay Scale –  Rs.25,500-81,100/- (Level-4)

Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Computer Based Examination (CBE), Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT), Trade Test and Proficiency in Computer Operation, Police verification of character & antecedents and Medical Examination of finally selected candidates.
Those who qualify the cut-off marks will be eligible for the next stage of recruitment.
After the Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (PEMT), the final merit list will be published on the official website.
Selection will be based on written exam, PEMT, medical tests, and overall merit.
